name: WiserReview for WooCommerce
author: Wisernotify team

sections.description:
Wiser Review makes it easy to collect authentic product reviews and testimonials using the WiserReview platform. Embed customizable review forms on your product pages, thank you pages, or customer dashboards – no coding needed.

Perfect for ecommerce stores that want to boost trust, social proof, and SEO using customer reviews and UGC (user-generated content).

🔑 Key Features
– Embed any WiserReview form using shortcode or block
– Auto-fill customer info (name, email, product) in the form
– Show forms on product pages, order thank you page, or My Account
– Auto-tag reviews by product, order, or campaign
– Supports image uploads, star ratings, consent checkboxes, and more
– Seamlessly integrates with WiserReview widgets, automation, and incentives

WiserReview platform features include:
– Custom Forms Module
– Incentives and Coupons for leaving a review
– Moderation filters, tagging, auto-publish workflows
– Carousel, Wall, Popup, and Floating Badge widgets
– Social sharing to Instagram, WhatsApp, Klaviyo, and more

Note: Requires a WiserReview account to use. Create a free account.

External Services

This plugin connects to the WiserReview API to enable its features, such as collecting, managing, and displaying product reviews and testimonials. Below is a detailed explanation of the external service usage:

  1. Service Name: WiserReview API
    • Purpose: The API is used to verify your WiserReview account, send order data, and retrieve review forms and widgets for display on your WooCommerce store.
    • Data Sent:
      • Account verification: API key is sent during the account verification process.
      • Order data: Order details (e.g., product name, customer email, and order ID) are sent to associate reviews with specific orders.
      • Automation data: Automation IDs and related metadata are sent to trigger workflows.
    • When Data is Sent:
      • During account verification when connecting your WiserReview account.
      • When an order is placed, to associate reviews with the order.
      • When review forms or widgets are loaded on your site.
    • Service Provider: WiserReview
    • Terms of Service: https://wiserreview.com/terms-conditions//
    • Privacy Policy: https://wiserreview.com/privacypolicy/

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and privacy policy of WiserReview.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install directly via WordPress Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Go to WooCommerce > WiserReview Settings
  4. Connect your WiserReview account
  5. Choose your default form and where you’d like it to appear (product page, thank you page, etc.)
  6. Save and publish!

Use [wiserreview_form id="FORM_ID"] shortcode to place forms anywhere.
sections.faq:
Do I need a WiserReview account?

Yes. You can sign up here. It’s quick and free to get started.

Can I show different forms for different products?

Yes, you can dynamically pass product info to a single form or use multiple forms as needed.

Does it support UGC (images/videos)?

Yes – the form can include image upload fields for collecting user-generated content.

Can I use this without WooCommerce?

No – this plugin is specifically designed to enhance WooCommerce workflows.
